phases.name: Start of Round
phases.summary: Roll the Kiln Die for this round's starting Base Heat; rotate Orders; refill displays; ready abilities.
phases.summaryZh: 掷窑骰，定出本轮基础火候的起点；轮换委托榜；补齐各公开区；重置“每轮一次”的能力。

phases.name: Work Phase
phases.summary: Alternate worker placements at central and personal locations.
phases.summaryZh: 轮流派工到中央地点与坊内地点。

phases.name: Firing Phase
phases.summary: Contributions → Base Heat → Test Pieces → Heat markers → Fire → Actual Heat → Quality.
phases.summaryZh: 控火 → 基础火候 → 火照 → 翻火标 → 翻窑火 → 实际火候 → 定品。

phases.name: Order Phase
phases.summary: Complete held Orders, one at a time, in turn order.
phases.summaryZh: 按回合顺序，逐张完成在手委托。

phases.name: Cleanup
phases.summary: Return workers and markers; trim Order hands; pass First Player.
phases.summaryZh: 收回工人与标记；削减手中委托；传递起始玩家标。
